name: cursor-db-skills
description: Inspect, query, export, import, move, and repair Cursor sessions in state.vscdb. Four skills: db-core (shared utilities), inspector (read-only queries), surgeon (write operations), and session-export (3-format archival).

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, export, import, and repair Cursor's session database
interface.longDescription: Four complementary skills for working with Cursor's state.vscdb SQLite database: read-only inspection (schema, entities, queries), write operations (import, move, pin), full-fidelity session export (raw_store + AgentLog + ASI), and a shared core module for cross-platform DB access.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Cursor database — how many sessions do I have?
Export this Cursor session to AgentLog format
Move sessions from one workspace to another
